Government warns messaging platforms on fraud, cybersecurity a priority

The Indian government has declared cybersecurity a top priority, especially as public services increasingly move online. Officials acknowledged that no system is entirely secure and warned that messaging platforms will be held responsible if new features facilitate fraud. This comes amid concerns highlighted by actions against Telegram during the NEET-UG reexamination.
